en.title: 7 Essential MCU Films Before 'Avengers: Doomsday' Encore
en.summary: With 'Avengers: Doomsday' hitting theaters again, dive back into the foundational MCU epics that set the stage for the ultimate showdown.
en.body:
## 1. Iron Man (2008)
Before the Avengers assembled, Tony Stark was busy building his empire, both technologically and metaphorically. This film, released by Paramount Pictures, single-handedly launched the MCU with Robert Downey Jr.'s charismatic performance and a grounded, yet thrilling, origin story that proved comic book movies could be sophisticated and entertaining.

## 2. Iron Man 2 (2010)
While sometimes overlooked, this sequel is crucial for introducing key players and setting up future conflicts. It deepens Tony Stark's character, brings in Black Widow, and lays the groundwork for Thor's arrival and the eventual formation of the Avengers, making it a vital connective tissue.

## 3. The Incredible Hulk (2008)
Although featuring a different lead actor (Edward Norton), this film is important for establishing Bruce Banner's struggle and providing a raw, intense look at the Hulk's power. It also features crucial post-credit scenes that tie directly into the larger MCU narrative.

## 4. Thor (2011)
Journeying to Asgard, this film introduces the God of Thunder and his complex family dynamics, including Loki. Its blend of cosmic fantasy and Shakespearean drama, produced by Marvel Studios, is essential for understanding the celestial threats and powerful beings that will eventually join the fight.

## 5. The Avengers (2012)
The culmination of Marvel's Phase One, this Joss Whedon-directed masterpiece brought Earth's Mightiest Heroes together for the first time. Witnessing the team dynamic, their initial friction, and eventual triumph against Loki's Chitauri invasion is non-negotiable for appreciating the stakes in 'Doomsday'.

## 6. Iron Man 3 (2013)
This entry provides a fascinating look at Tony Stark grappling with the aftermath of the Battle of New York. It explores his PTSD and the evolution of his relationship with his technology, offering a personal perspective on the hero's journey that resonates through his later appearances.

## 7. Captain Marvel (2019)
Set in the 1990s, this film introduces Carol Danvers and her immense cosmic power, which becomes pivotal in later MCU events, including the fight against Thanos. Understanding her origins and capabilities is key to grasping the full might of the heroes facing 'Doomsday'.
Bottom Line: Revisit these foundational MCU films to fully appreciate the epic journey leading to 'Avengers: Doomsday'.

content_raw: Before Avengers: Doomsday finally comes out this December, Marvel Studios has decided to do yet another re-release of Avengers: Endgame titled Avengers Endgame: Encore . With three minutes of Avengers: Doomsday content —only for IMAX and Infinity Vision viewers, for some weird reason, and only a small sneak peek for non-premium viewers—people are definitely popping out to see this project before the next big event film.
